title: Marguerite and the Cipher
author: Emrys Blackwood
blurb: Isandro Sterling, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
